owned_storage.basis: per-store-Vec-capacity-peaks-and-logical-owner-transfers; excludes bridge containers, cold payloads and primitive Rc events

call_buffers_scope: producer-local-successful-capacity-and-copy-observations; not total allocator or retain/release accounting
vm_phase_samples_basis: first-4096-attempts-per-phase; includes errors; [inclusive,exclusive] ns; child phases share one exclusive clock

call_preparation.basis: cumulative-capacities; argument-buffers-are-observations; excludes bound/apply scratch and total Runtime retains

execution_diagnostics.basis: logical-profiled-events; no timing; executed-functions-only except compiler_rejections; max 4096 functions, 16384 sites per category, 4 callee identities per callsite
execution_diagnostics.callsite_scope: ordinary-driver-enter-selected-only; other call and construct paths are excluded
